items.title: Cohomological classification of definable Galois extensions for fixed internality data via binding groupoids
items.author: David Meretzky
items.difficulty_reason: The main multiplicity construction generalizes Picard-Vessiot classification to fixed internality data in totally transcendental theories. The full binding groupoid, definable fundamental systems, intrinsic/extrinsic equivalence relations, torsor transport and cohomological connecting-map argument are retained; the extension-class injection and the vanishing-dependent converse count as one theorem. All original torsor/group-structure and existence assumptions remain explicit, with original discussion that they are not automatic. Old210631 only contains an internality remark444–446 and its local proof448–463, not this groupoid/multiplicity construction. Later colimit formulas and boundedness proposals are uncounted context.

primary.label: Original three-part binding-group/torsor and multiplicity theorem, including injection and vanishing-dependent bijection

proof_spans.label: Complete prime-model/minimal-closure, definable cohomology, internality and binding-groupoid construction with original support arguments
Complete equivalence/group-action construction, extension-to-torsor injection and cohomological converse with assumption discussion

contexts.label: Original motivation, repeated main statement with all three assumptions and author acknowledgments
Original differential/model-theoretic colimit and boundedness developments retained uncounted
